name: 01-speak
head: Speak. It types.
sub: Tap the bubble beside your keyboard and polished words land right where you're typing.

callouts.text: Clean text, right at your cursor
Your recording bubble sits beside the keyboard

name: 02-tap-or-hold
head: Tap, or hold to talk
sub: Tap to start and tap the check to finish, or hold the bubble and let go.

name: 03-polish
head: Polish on your phone
sub: Superwhisper's S1-mini runs right on your phone, or use your own OpenAI, Claude or Gemini key.

callouts.text: Pick where polish runs: off, this phone or cloud

name: 04-style
head: Your tone. Your format.
sub: Choose casual to formal, turn spoken lists into bullets, and lay out emails for you.

name: 05-cleanup
head: Cleans up as you speak
sub: Filler words gone, spoken emoji and punctuation turned into the real thing, your spelling.

name: 06-dictionary
head: Teach it your names
sub: Add names and terms, plus the ways they get misheard, to help it recognize your words.

callouts.text: Aliases catch how a word gets misheard

name: 07-history
head: Every dictation, saved on your phone
sub: Search what you said and copy it again any time. History stays on this phone.

callouts.text: Open any dictation to copy it again

name: 08-privacy
head: Your voice never leaves your phone
sub: Speech turns into text on your phone. Cloud polish is optional and sends text only, under your own key.

callouts.text: Cloud polish only with your own key
